messages:
Sam Rivera: Heads-up: I'm starting a small patch to align glossary terms with SDK parameters. Found about 26 mismatches across the quickstart and the API reference.
Tori Kim: Thanks. Do you have a sample mapping? We should avoid changing public param names in SDK docs without a migration plan.
Sam Rivera: Yep, mapping in the draft PR: 'max_tokens' -> 'maxTokens', 'stop_sequences' -> 'stopSequences', 'prompt_text' -> 'prompt'. I'm proposing we keep docs canonical as snake_case and show SDK camelCase in examples.
Diego Alvarez: Can we instead adopt the approach: canonical term in docs (snake_case), then code examples show the SDK form, with a short tooltip line: 'Docs canonical: <term>'. That's what I saw works best for readers.
Nina Patel: Small wording note for voice: prefer "Set max tokens" over "Maximum tokens can be set". Keep imperative and concise. Also, clarify when we mean config key vs human-facing label.
Sam Rivera: Good point. I'll add a short blurb in the style guide section called "Naming in docs vs SDK". Draft snippet: 
```python
# docs canonical term shown above snippet: max_tokens
client.generate(model="r-instruct", maxTokens=512)  # SDK camelCase example
```
Tori Kim: Add an inline note about searchability: users often paste "maxTokens" into search — let's ensure the glossary includes both spellings as aliases.
DocsBot: Link check: found 3 broken links in api-reference/generation.md (line ~120). Create a follow-up ticket? :warning:
Sam Rivera: I'll fix the broken links in the PR and attach the ticket for tracking.
Diego Alvarez: For the migration guide, propose a short table: legacy param | canonical term | SDK alias | migration snippet. Keep it under 6 rows for the first pass.
Nina Patel: Also include a short deprecation banner pattern we can reuse: yellow callout with "Deprecation: SDK alias will be removed after YYYY-MM-DD" and link to RFC.
Tori Kim: Devs: will SDK accept both forms for the next 3 months? Marco from runtime said yes earlier this month. If so, we can publish migration notes now.
Sam Rivera: I'll confirm with Marco and add a one-liner in the PR describing compatibility window.
DocsBot: PR template tip: add label `docs/migration` so it shows up in the weekly migration sweep.
Sam Rivera: Assigning: I will open PR, Diego you can add the mapping table, Nina the voice blurb, Tori please confirm alias retention window. I'll ping product for final naming sign-off before merge.
Tori Kim: Got it. I'll confirm alias window by EOD tomorrow.
Nina Patel: Quick microcopy suggestion: use "SDK: <alias>" when showing the param form in prose, and use backticks in code blocks.
Diego Alvarez: Also adding one test to docs CI: ensure glossary search returns both canonical and alias terms.
Sam Rivera: Thanks team. I'll post the PR link here once created. If anyone wants to tweak phrasing, leave PR comments so we can iterate quickly.
